children: The operator behind Trump Digital Gold (GOLD) sold all of its held GOLD tokens two hours ago, according to Ember monitoring. According to Foresight News, the sale covered 82.454% of the token supply and generated 9,784.6 SOL.
The token was created on Solana at 7:38 AM today. The operator controlled about 82.454% of the supply, or roughly 824.54 million tokens, through allocations and post-launch purchases.

title: Trump Digital Gold Scam Operator Sells Entire GOLD Token Stake
